mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(A.bidx, R.bidx) AS bidx, B.coverImg, B.title, B.originalTitle, B.subtitle, B.author, B.publisher, DATE_FORMAT(B.publishedYear, '%Y.%m.%d') AS publishedYear, B.totalPages, B.isbn, B.sizeWidth, B.sizeHeight, B.weight, B.category, A.aidx FROM APPROVAL AS A LEFT JOIN REQUEST AS R ON A.rqidx = R.rqidx LEFT JOIN BOOKS AS B ON B.bidx = COALESCE(A.bidx, R.bidx) WHERE A.delyn = 'N' AND (B.delyn = 'N' OR B.delyn IS NULL) AND A.aidx = #{aidx}
mapper.update: update APPROVAL set regyn='Y', modify=now() where aidx=#{aidx}
update APPROVAL set regyn='N', modify=now() where aidx=#{aidx}
